nodes.label: Shopify Submission Format column map
nodes.rationale: Source of truth is vertx_product_submission_sample.csv, a Matrixify (Excelify) sheet, not a native Shopify CSV. Column order does not matter to Matrixify, names do; unused columns can be omitted. The header row is reproduced verbatim from the sample.

nodes.label: Matrixify multi-row product model
nodes.rationale: Row 1 carries product-level fields + variant 1 + image 1; one row per further variant; trailing rows carry only Handle + Image Src + Image Position for gallery overflow. Product-level fields appear only on the first row.

nodes.label: Option1/2 value resolution
nodes.rationale: Woo option values come from parent attributes[].terms joined to variations by id; fallback = variation label string; fallback = synthesised grid. Option1 Name = Colour for multi-colour products, Title for single-variant; single-variant Option1 Value = Default Title.

nodes.label: clean_description() HTML cleaning
nodes.rationale: Strips page-builder scaffolding (Magento PageBuilder, Avada/Fusion Builder, wrapper divs, <style>), keeps headings/lists/paragraphs. Default is cleaned HTML; the sample keeps raw markup. Open question for the client: cleaned vs raw.
